title.zh-CN: 腹痛与显著血小板增多 · 5岁女孩
title.en: Abdominal pain and marked thrombocytosis · girl aged 5

summary.zh-CN: 血小板极高且抗感染后持续，需区分反应性和克隆性病因并兼顾出血风险。
summary.en: Extreme thrombocytosis persists after antibiotics; distinguish reactive and clonal causes while considering bleeding risk.

provenance.citation: 凌晨, 朱光华, 金玲, 吴润晖, 马晓珍. 学龄前期发病的儿童原发性血小板增多症一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2013;51(07):541-542. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2013.07.016.

text.zh-CN: 报告治疗中第2天短暂无热惊厥，增强MRI未见异常；给予羟基脲、干扰素和阿司匹林等，15天血小板559×10⁹/L，5个月220–390×10⁹/L且无再腹痛。单例不能确证惊厥机制或长期疗效。

prompt.zh-CN: 持续极高血小板应怎样鉴别？
prompt.en: How should persistent extreme thrombocytosis be assessed?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 同时评估反应性原因和骨髓增殖性疾病
text.en: Assess reactive causes and a myeloproliferative disorder

feedback.zh-CN: 持续血象和巨核增殖使克隆性原因需要进一步证据。
feedback.en: Persistent counts and megakaryocytic proliferation warrant clonal assessment.

text.zh-CN: 腹痛即可证明全部为感染反应
text.en: Abdominal pain proves an infectious reactive process

feedback.zh-CN: 症状和低CRP均不能独立定因。
feedback.en: Neither symptoms nor low CRP independently establish causation.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭血小板数即可确定具体肿瘤亚型
text.en: Platelet count alone identifies the neoplasm subtype

feedback.zh-CN: 需要骨髓、分子及排除性证据。
feedback.en: Marrow, molecular and exclusion evidence are needed.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 骨髓与JAK2结果支持报告的原发性血小板增多，但儿童分类仍需专科复核
text.en: Marrow and JAK2 support reported essential thrombocythaemia, with specialist review of childhood classification

feedback.zh-CN: 不能把成人风险模型未经验证直接套用儿童。
feedback.en: Adult risk models should not automatically be applied to children.

text.zh-CN: JAK2阳性等于已经发生血栓
text.en: JAK2 positivity proves an existing thrombosis

feedback.zh-CN: 变异支持克隆性，不替代血栓影像。
feedback.en: A clonal marker is not thrombosis imaging.

text.zh-CN: BCR–ABL阴性排除所有髓系肿瘤
text.en: Negative BCR–ABL excludes all myeloid neoplasms

prompt.zh-CN: 如何权衡预防血栓与治疗出血风险？
prompt.en: How should thrombotic and bleeding risks be balanced?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 儿血液团队评估出血、获得性VWF异常及神经症状后个体化治疗
text.en: Paediatric haematology should assess bleeding, acquired VWF dysfunction and neurological symptoms before individualised care

feedback.zh-CN: 极高血小板不能直接等同于任何儿童都应立即自行用阿司匹林。
feedback.en: Extreme counts do not justify unsupervised aspirin in every child.

text.zh-CN: 按报告剂量自行长期阿司匹林即可
text.en: Self-administer the report’s aspirin dose indefinitely

feedback.zh-CN: 出血及年龄相关风险需专科评估。
feedback.en: Bleeding and age-specific risks need specialist assessment.

text.zh-CN: 短暂抽搐无需进一步评估
text.en: A brief seizure needs no reassessment

feedback.zh-CN: 新神经症状需及时评估，正常MRI不能解释一切。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：比较反应性与克隆性血小板增多的证据。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：VWF功能、儿童专科现行诊断复核、惊厥机制及长期转归。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Compare evidence for reactive and clonal thrombocytosis. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: VWF function, contemporary paediatric diagnostic review, seizure mechanism and long-term outcome. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告诊断儿童原发性血小板增多症，需避免将血小板数或单一变异当作全部风险判断。
conclusion.en: The report diagnoses childhood essential thrombocythaemia; count or mutation alone does not define all risks.

boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.
